connection_fields.name: account
connection_fields.description: account identifier, e.g. myorg-myaccount (or a locator like xy12345.eu-west-1)

connection_fields.name: user
connection_fields.description: the user to sign in as

connection_fields.name: authenticator
connection_fields.description: how to sign in: snowflake (password, the default), username_password_mfa, externalbrowser, oauth, jwt, programmatic_access_token, workload_identity, or an Okta URL; a private key means key-pair sign-in

connection_fields.name: password
connection_fields.description: password (or a programmatic access token)

connection_fields.name: private_key_path
connection_fields.description: path to a key-pair private key (PEM), for key-pair sign-in

connection_fields.name: private_key
connection_fields.description: a key-pair private key, inline (PEM, or base64 DER)

connection_fields.name: private_key_passphrase
connection_fields.description: the private key's passphrase, if it's encrypted

connection_fields.name: role
connection_fields.description: role to use

connection_fields.name: warehouse
connection_fields.description: warehouse to run queries on

connection_fields.name: database
connection_fields.description: default database

connection_fields.name: schema
connection_fields.description: default schema

connection_fields.name: token
connection_fields.description: OAuth access token, JWT, programmatic access token, or OIDC token for workload identity

connection_fields.name: oauth_client_id
connection_fields.description: OAuth client ID, to renew `token` as a refresh token

connection_fields.name: oauth_client_secret
connection_fields.description: OAuth client secret, to renew `token` as a refresh token

connection_fields.name: workload_identity_provider
connection_fields.description: for workload_identity: AWS, AZURE, GCP or OIDC

connection_fields.name: workload_identity_entra_resource
connection_fields.description: for workload_identity on Azure: the Entra resource

connection_fields.name: query_tag
connection_fields.description: tag for every query of the session

connection_fields.name: client_session_keep_alive
connection_fields.description: keep the session alive while a long report runs

connection_fields.name: client_request_mfa_token
connection_fields.description: cache the MFA token (username_password_mfa) in the OS keychain

connection_fields.name: client_store_temporary_credential
connection_fields.description: cache the SSO token (externalbrowser) in the OS keychain

connection_fields.name: retries
connection_fields.description: how many times to try connecting again after a temporary error (0: never)

connection_fields.name: connect_retries
connection_fields.description: dbt's name for `retries`

connection_fields.name: connect_timeout
connection_fields.description: how long to wait for a connection (`30s`, `2m`, or seconds)

connection_fields.name: host
connection_fields.description: Snowflake host, when not <account>.snowflakecomputing.com

connection_fields.name: port
connection_fields.description: port, with host

connection_fields.name: protocol
connection_fields.description: https (default) or http, with host

connection_fields.name: insecure_mode
connection_fields.description: skip the certificate revocation check

connection_fields.name: proxy_host
connection_fields.description: HTTP proxy host

connection_fields.name: proxy_port
connection_fields.description: HTTP proxy port
